description: Native notifications for the private in-app loopback gateway on macOS, Windows and Linux. Its sibling loopback-notifications names android and iOS only, and a capability that names any platform applies to no other, so every packaged desktop client was silent: the main window is loaded from http://localhost:<port>, which is a remote URL, and the only other capability holding notification:default has no remote block and therefore covers local app URLs alone. Kept as a second file rather than widening the first because apps/desktop/verify-native-config.mjs pins that file's platform list exactly.
